support.responseRule: Stop new pilot use immediately on any stop condition; preserve evidence before repair or replacement.

deviceInventory.pilotRule: Before handout, freeze the admitted physical-device roster and record only privacy-safe device identifiers. The emulator is a support target, not a pilot handout target.

stopConditions: LR-07 is not CLOSED or any governed production artifact or GitHub Release remains live after containment.
The admitted user roster, approved state, role set, Rules, indexes, callable authority or backend release identity differs from the closed F5 evidence.
Any target reports an unrecognized or incomplete local-store provenance marker, requires governed recovery, loses its database generation unexpectedly, or loses rows during upgrade or restart.
Any target reports unsynced local rows, unresolved synchronization rejections, failed reconnect reconciliation, repeated startup failure, or a sign-in or revocation control failure.
Production PITR or delete protection is disabled, the native backup posture no longer satisfies P-05, or the isolated restore evidence becomes unavailable.
A privacy incident, uncontrolled package transfer, unapproved target, unapproved user, or unrestricted-distribution path is observed.
The exact Build 11 package hash, signer, source commit, built tag, custody record or support ownership cannot be reproduced.

backupAndRestore.restoreRule: Never import a local recovery package automatically. Preserve the original package, verify hashes, and perform any repair or Firestore restore only under a separate governed incident record.

allowedEvidence: exact source, package, receipt and UI-capture hashes
row counts and unsynced or rejection counts
prohibitedEvidence: raw database files in the repository
raw device serial numbers in the repository
business-record payloads in support or governance evidence

firstActions: Stop new pilot operations and package handout.
Preserve the device, current app data, privacy-safe diagnostics and a fresh recovery package without uninstalling or clearing data.
Record exact package, source, signer, roster, Rules, indexes, backend identity, sync and provenance state.
Revoke the affected user's approved state when authority containment is required.
Classify whether the fault is local-store, synchronization, authority, backend, distribution or privacy related before mutation.
rollbackPaths: For local-store risk, retain Build 11 and recover from the sealed app-native package only after marker and file-hash adjudication.
For backend or Rules regression, restore only an exact previously sealed source and deployment authority under separate approval, then repeat strict live readback.
For user or device compromise, revoke approval, exclude the target from the frozen roster and preserve audit evidence.
For artifact exposure, re-arm LR-07 and contain only the exact exposed artifact while preserving runs, tags and logs.

pilotAcceptanceScript: Verify LR-07 is CLOSED against the exact current source and zero live production artifacts or GitHub Releases.
Verify the admitted physical-device roster, pilot-user roster, roles and approved state are frozen and within the governed ceiling.
Verify the installed package is Build 11, signed by the admitted production certificate and matches the exact governed package authority.
Cold-start and confirm the expected role-specific home without permission, crash or token-race failure.
Capture the privacy-safe local diagnostic and require COMMITTED, EXISTING_STORE_CANONICAL_CURRENT, schema 3, recognized fingerprint, zero unsynced rows and zero unresolved rejections.
Run a normal manual synchronization and require a successful marker with no row loss.
Exercise offline creation or update, reconnect, and require exactly-once reconciliation with no permanent rejection.
Revoke one admitted test user and require denial on the next protected operation; restore only the exact pre-test authority after evidence is sealed.
Exercise at least one wrong-role operation and require denial without privileged data exposure or mutation.
Create and hash a fresh app-native recovery package, then confirm production PITR, delete protection, native backups and isolated restore authority remain current.
Record acceptance, exceptions and stop-condition status. Any failure leaves pilot handout NOT_AUTHORIZED.
